title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 19.Urges the Commission to make full use of the Financial Regulation, notably the EDES, where persons and entities promote Islamist entryism, radicalisation, antisemitism, terrorism, incitement to discrimination, hatred or violence or other activities incompatible with the values of the EU, asks the Commission to present the measures necessary to strengthen the EU’s capacity to prevent these entities from accessing EU funding, including follow-up supervision to prevent and remedy attempts to circumvent exclusion by a given organisation which has previously failed to comply with the requirement to respect the EU’s fundamental values; calls on the Commission and other EU bodies to proactively check and strengthen the verification of compliance with EU values of applicants and beneficiaries of EU funding in order to detect potential breaches;
